name: Park Hyatt Zurich
positioning: Contemporary city-center hotel on Beethovenstrasse, a short walk from Lake Zurich, with a modern art collection and a Biologique Recherche spa
best_for: Travelers who want a central Zurich base near the lake and Bahnhofstrasse
Families who want connecting family rooms and welcome amenities for children

facts.text: The hotel is at Beethovenstrasse 21 in Zurich.
Bahnhofstrasse is 1.5 kilometers from the hotel.
The hotel is in the center of town, under five minutes from the lake.
Bathrooms are stocked with Le Labo products.
The Lobby Lounge menu features Swiss-inspired dishes made with seasonal, locally sourced ingredients.
The Park Hyatt Zurich Spa offers treatments by Biologique Recherche.
The hotel's fitness and spa area is called Club Olympus.
Pets are welcome and get a dog bed, fresh water and homemade treats in the room.
Family rooms are two connecting rooms, and staff can deliver special welcome amenities for young guests.
The hotel offers a private boat charter on Lake Zurich.
The hotel offers chauffeured limousine service to and from Zurich Airport.
A 24-hour public parking garage beneath the hotel has spaces reserved for hotel guests.

highlights.text: There are nearly 100 original modern art pieces around the building.
The Wellbeing Suite has a private fitness room with Technogym equipment.
The Afternoon Tea features teas, champagne and sweet and savory treats crafted by Pastry Chef Tilo Herber.
The Presidential Suite has a private elevator, a dedicated entrance and a reception area.
Guests can borrow bikes from reception to cycle around the lake.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning and Zurich's high-cost market.
WhataHotel notes that the urban setting may lack scenic mountain or lake views from all rooms.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Park Hyatt Zurich
